d: Short, messy ash-white hair with choppy bangs, topped with a large magenta rose and a translucent black veil. Wide, glowing magenta eyes with a cheerful, wide-eyed expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender, petite build wearing a gothic lolita dress featuring a dark purple and black palette with white ruffled trim, a black bow at the neck, and dark purple boots with matching ribbons. Signature details include a heavy black iron chain draped across the chest, green crystalline growths sprouting from the back and arms, and a large, monstrous purple and green clawed appendage extending from the left side.
